preconditions.description: The length of the input string S is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of iterations R is between 1 and 20, inclusive.
The index N is within the bounds of the final string length after R iterations.

postconditions.expression: output == S[N] for S after R iterations
postconditions.description: The output is the character at index N of the final string after R iterations.
